frozen_programme: QPF004 of the original 2026-11-17 six-source original Q–P–F atlas

source.source_paper: Gallagher and Campbell 2020, American Journal of Botany 107:445–455

original_atlas_error.correction_type: species, family and full biological programme identity (Mimulus/Erythranthe=Phrymaceae vs Mertensia=Boraginaceae)
original_atlas_error.policy: Do not edit outcome-blind registered list in PR #66 in place. Preserve audit log and comment with source-linked erratum.

phenology_2015.observation_hours_normal_per_week: 15 except final week; week-four initial 15 hours had zero observed visitors and cut stems were then added to the pots before a second 15 hours
phenology_2015.Q: repeated 30-minute counts of flower-visiting taxa and open flowers per plant; different effort and manipulated display in last week
phenology_2015.P: stigma squash pollen grains, on approx 5.2 +/- 0.7 sampled flowers per plant
phenology_2015.F: mature seeds per individually tagged flowers averaged per potted plant
phenology_2015.candidate_join_grain: planted individual / experimental array / phenology group / week, not necessarily same flower Q-P-F

single_visit_2016.Q: observed one visitor to virgin flowers with insect taxon recorded, some multiple visited flowers within ramet
single_visit_2016.P: conspecific and heterospecific grains from some marked stigmas (possibly subset), aggregation to ramet means when more than one marked flower
single_visit_2016.F: mature seed count per marked flower or ramet-average set; lost/herbivorized seed-failure ramets excluded from published analyses
single_visit_2016.candidate_join_grain: ramet/flower and clone-control triplet + source site, NOT 235 independent pollen-and-seed joint rows
single_visit_2016.critical_gate: verify actual shared 2016 ramet/marked-flower IDs between recorded insect treatment, stigma pollen and mature seed values; ascertain seed/fruit losses, repeated clone groups

same_programme_but_other_published_study.manipulations: experimental flowering time × soil moisture; visitor group composition and seed output
same_programme_but_other_published_study.p_endpoint_unverified: No direct pollen deposition/paternity established from abstract; do not label QPF

schema_only_decision.confidence: Published biological frame supported, original row-level interface pending source bytes.
schema_only_decision.admission_rule: Only after source XLSX headers and IDs establish 2016 within-ramet/stigma/seed match and source outcome completeness, freeze a distinct original comparative model before opening new phenotype values.
schema_only_decision.never_substitute: Use no 2015 plant-level visitor counts as if same flower as 2016 single visit. No cross-year source plant ID joins inferred from type or place.
